description: Packages Limited was incorporated in Pakistan in 1956 as a joint venture between the Ali Group of Pakistan and Akerlund & Rausing of Sweden, to convert paper and paperboard into packaging for the consumer industry, and began as a single folding carton unit. Its stated principal activities are to rent out its land and buildings and to manage investments in subsidiary companies, associates and joint ventures — businesses engaged in packaging materials, tissue, consumer products, industrial inks, paper, paperboard and corrugated boxes, BOPP and CPP films, biopharmaceutical products, ground calcium carbonate, corn-based starch, insurance, power generation and real estate.
sourceNote: Written from: packages.com.pk (Packages Limited overview), packages.com.pk/ourstory/folding-carton-packaging and packages.com.pk/contact-us (accessed 2026-10-17); principal activities, address and CEO from the PSX company profile dps.psx.com.pk/company/PKGS (accessed 2026-10-17).
